answer: Attestations only count if the attesting agents sit at graph distance two or more from the attested identity, and each edge must carry a cedar-tagged bond locked for thirty days. To manufacture a fake identity, an attacker needs a mirror cluster of independent agents with real stake, and every forged link costs a slashed bond plus lost future sonnet royalties on verified work. Sparsely connected newcomers must pay escalating bond multipliers until their neighborhood widens, so fresh sybils get expensive fast.
